# Price the job by what actually drives the cost.

> Free bid calculator for licensed asbestos abatement contractors: price a removal job by OSHA/EPA containment class (I/II/III), square footage, crew and supervisor rates, air monitoring, and waste disposal — and see the gap against a flat rate per square foot.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
